name: What is the process for repairing a wooden window frame with rot?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing a wooden window frame with rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for repairing rotted wooden window frames begins with a thorough inspection to assess the extent of the rot. We carefully remove all decayed wood, treating the area to prevent future fungal growth. New wood is then precisely cut and fitted to replace the removed sections, often using epoxies and specialized fillers for structural reinforcement. The repaired area is then sanded, primed, and painted to match the existing frame, ensuring a seamless and durable restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: We inspect for rot, remove decayed wood, treat for fungus, then fit new wood sections with epoxy. The repair is then sanded, primed, and painted for a durable finish.
